verdict.rationale: Activepieces lets users describe automations/agents in plain language ('summarise my unread emails every morning', 'only reply to paying customers') and have flows/agents built automatically, plus exposes a built-in MCP server so natural-language AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Codex) can drive the whole platform. This is well documented across product, changelog, and MCP docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the natural-language agent-building experience beyond first-party docs.
